title: Paid Leave: Your Role and Responsibilities as an Employer
issuer: Washington Employment Security Department, Paid Family and Medical Leave

passages.question: What premium rate, wage cap and split apply to Paid Leave in 2026?
passages.excerpt: In 2026, the premium rate is 1.13% of each employee’s gross wages, not including tips, up to the 2026 Social Security cap ($184,500). ... In 2026, up to 71.43% can be paid by the employee. ... About 28.57% of the premium is the employer’s share. If your business has 50 or more employees, you must pay the employer share of the premium.
